head_commit.message:
Keep complete HIA evidence within the original repository asset rules

Split the unchanged execution archive into 58 parts of at most 458745 bytes. Preserve both complete native38 JSON reports as ordered UTF-8 parts with full original SHA256 and Git identities. Keep the original 512000-byte blob limit and spelling checks for all source and JSON text; exclude only the exact binary archive-part naming pattern.

Actual reconstruction and codespell 2.4.3 passed in job 1a21ef298f2-ffbe-56ab. Preserve the earlier failed CI observations. Production source, original owner assertions, budgets and archive bytes are unchanged; full workflow and whole-stack retirement remain pending.
